readings.Aries: There's more room in this situation than your first read suggested. Take a second look. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Taurus: You have built something. Someone nearby hasn't noticed. Decide whether that matters to you. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Gemini: You've told the story of yourself differently to different people. Which version is closest to true? This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Cancer: You are capable of a fierceness in protection that surprises people who only know your softness. Both are you. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Leo: There is a version of humility that doesn't cost you your confidence. Find it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: Your instinct to fix the thing is right. The thing you're trying to fix may not be the source of the problem. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Libra: You've been seeing both sides so long you've forgotten which one you were on originally. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Scorpio: There is something you want that you haven't admitted wanting. Admit it to yourself first. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Sagittarius: You said the true thing. Consider also the timing and the delivery. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Capricorn: The legacy you're building is real. Make sure it looks the way you actually want it to look. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: There is more warmth in you than your concepts allow for. Let some of it out today. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Pisces: The mood that comes in like water recedes like water too. Stay with it until it does. The question matters more than the answer right now.

sky_notes: Mercury appears retrograde today. Earth isn't overtaking Mercury — Mercury is lapping us on the inside track, so it appears to drift backwards against the stars. Your western blot is unaffected.
Venus appears retrograde today. Venus is passing between us and the Sun, so it appears to slide backwards for ~6 weeks. Gravity on your bench is unchanged.
Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing crescent: we see a growing sliver of the Moon's sunlit half as it moves ~12° further east of the Sun each day.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1.6° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
